name: Student Management System
tagline: Full-scale college ERP automating multi-tier academic operations with strict RBAC.
description: Production-grade college enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform designed to streamline administrative overhead and unify communication across administrators, instructors, and students through modular, role-tailored dashboards.
problem: Higher education institutions struggle with fragmented, manual systems across departments for attendance tracking, fee auditing, assignment submissions, timetable coordination, and grading pipelines.
solution: Built a centralized, responsive web platform with role-based access control (RBAC), dual JWT access/refresh token security, bulk academic record operations, and automated GPA computation.
metrics_and_highlights: Engineered 20+ secure RESTful API endpoints and 15+ relational-style MongoDB schemas.
Integrated 3 dedicated role dashboards: Admin (12 modules), Faculty (6 modules), and Student (9 modules).
Secured application perimeter using bcrypt (12 salt rounds), Helmet.js headers, rate-limiting (200 req/min), and NoSQL injection sanitization.

security_and_auth: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating Admin, Faculty, and Student portals
Dual-token authentication flow (15m JWT access tokens + 7d HTTP-only cookie refresh tokens)
Centralized API error handling, input validation, and route protection guards
admin_suite: Real-time institutional dashboard displaying aggregate student, faculty, and department metrics
Complete CRUD interfaces with search, filtering, and server pagination
Dynamic timetable builder with grid visualization and automated room/faculty allocation
Fee tracking, penalty auditing, and institutional notice board management
faculty_portal: Batch attendance tracking with bulk present/absent/late toggle controls
Assignment lifecycle management, student submission tracking, and grading workflows
Direct internal marks upload and leave request workflows
student_portal: Personalized academic hub displaying attendance percentages, fee balances, and GPA calculations
Assignment submission portal and real-time subject-wise timetable views
Leave application tracking and priority-tagged institutional announcements
